scope: All actuals.csv quarters, not selected on errors
revenue_definition: Retail-only petroleum revenue divided by reported chain retail gallons
q4_derivation: Annual retail-only revenue minus nine-month retail-only revenue
gap_definition_unchanged: Current revenue per gallon minus prior-year same-quarter revenue per gallon minus EIA basket year-over-year change
source_selection: Original period SEC 10Q/10K; original SEC earnings exhibit for reported same-store growth
source_gaps: Explicitly blocked or null; no total-petroleum substitution, inferred same-store growth, calendar fraction or future-quarter imputation
descriptive_comparisons: gap versus directly reported same-store gallon growth
previous-quarter gap versus next production error, only when gap source was published before target quarter end
statistics: Spearman correlation with average tied ranks
error_groups: Previously selected six largest misses versus other production OOF quarters; no retuned threshold
limitations: Taxes, product mix, geography, acquisitions and volume/time weighting remain unmatched
Contemporaneous gap is post-results and not a live forecasting input
Annual-minus-YTD can incorporate revisions; comparatives checked against archived current-period sources
Correlations are exploratory after previous historical model development, not prospective evidence
2019 prior-year market data is absent; first-year gaps remain blocked
Original retail-revenue revisions are not exhaustively audited
